_comment_formulations: Which formulations to sweep. Omit or leave empty for the default three (Explicit, ExplicitVarPro, Implicit). Add "Dense" to also run the explicitly-formed Schur complement baseline. Overridden by the VARPRO_FORMULATION env var (comma-separated), which is how one formulation is isolated per process for memory measurement.
_comment_max_dense_gb: Refuse to form a dense reduced system larger than this many GB. Skipped runs are still recorded, with skip_reason=dense_too_large and the dense_gb it would have needed. At 8 GB this covers 49/51 standard datasets; mrclam2 (39.8 GB) and mrclam4 (29.0 GB) are excluded.
_comment_skip_substrings: Dataset discovery is 'any leaf dir holding a .pyfg'. These families are the robust-experiment datasets (run via run_cosmobench_irls_gnc_sweep.py), have no inits/, and are not part of the standard benchmark.
_comment_sfm_use_scaled_stiefel: false = solve SfM on the plain Stiefel manifold (no per-pose scales, no log-barrier); true = use (R_{>0} x St(p,k))^n with the scale_reg_weight log-barrier. NOTE: gpu_paper_experiments always uses scaled Stiefel, so CPU and GPU SfM results are not comparable while this is false.
